THER.label: Knee Physiotherapy
THER.helps: Knee pain from osteoarthritis, ligament injuries, and stiffness after knee replacement. Builds strength so walking and stairs feel easier.
steps: Assessment of pain, swelling and range of movement
Heat or ice therapy and gentle joint mobilisation
Quadriceps and hamstring strengthening
A simple home exercise plan for off days

THER.label: Back & Spine Care
THER.helps: Lower back pain, disc problems, sciatica and posture-related neck pain — common for desk workers and long-distance drivers.
steps: Posture and spine movement assessment
Pain relief with TENS or manual therapy
Core and back-muscle strengthening
Ergonomic advice for work and sleep

THER.label: Stroke Rehabilitation
THER.helps: Regaining movement, balance and independence after a stroke — ideally starting within weeks of discharge.
steps: Neuro assessment of strength, tone and balance
Assisted movement of the weaker arm and leg
Sitting, standing and walking practice
Family training for safe transfers at home

THER.label: Shoulder Mobility
THER.helps: Frozen shoulder, rotator cuff strain and stiffness after fractures. Restores reach for everyday tasks like combing hair.
steps: Range-of-movement measurement
Joint mobilisation and gentle stretching
Rotator cuff and shoulder-blade exercises
Progress check and home routine update

THER.label: Speech & Swallow Therapy
THER.helps: Speech delay in children, unclear speech after stroke, and swallowing difficulty (dysphagia) that makes eating unsafe.
steps: Speech, language and swallow screening
Oral-motor exercises for lips, tongue and jaw
Safe swallowing techniques and food textures
Practice activities for the family

THER.label: Occupational Therapy
THER.helps: Hand weakness, fine-motor delays in children, and relearning daily-living skills like dressing, eating and writing.
steps: Daily-activity and hand-function assessment
Grip, pinch and coordination exercises
Practising real tasks with home objects
Small home changes for safety and independence
